name: handoff-revive-marketplace
description: Marketplace hosting the handoff-revive plugin for cheap session resumption.

plugins.name: handoff-revive
plugins.description: Cross-session handoff checkpoint — saves a compact handoff file (~1–3k tokens) instead of replaying your entire prior session via `claude --resume`. Auto-saves at 90%/95% usage (synced with UI notification, per-session toggleable).
